Marrow signal is within normal limits.

INTERPRETATION: 

Patella alta with moderate chondromalacia patella. There is also edema in Hoffa's fat inferior to the patella laterally compatible with the extensor mechanism impingement.

There is no evidence of internal derangement.

Indication: 65-year-old female with 2 weeks of left knee pain.

MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. Small subchondral insufficiency fracture of the medial tibial plateau with associated marrow edema. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Moderate joint effusion. Multiple intra-articular bodies measuring up to 0.9 cm. Large complex Baker's cyst.

Medial meniscus: Complex tear of the medial meniscus body and posterior horn, with a dominant radial component in the posterior horn, and high-grade tear of the posterior root attachment.
Medial compartment cartilage: Moderate chondrosis, with full-thickness cartilage loss and subchondral edema in the medial femoral condyle and the posterior tibial plateau. Marginal osteophytes.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Moderate chondrosis, with full-thickness cartilage loss in the tibial plateau. Marginal osteophytes.

Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Moderate chondrosis, with full-thickness cartilage loss of the lateral patellar facet, with subchondral edema. Full-thickness cartilage fissuring in the central femoral trochlea.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: Mild patellar tendinosis. No tendon tear.

Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 14 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
Popliteus tendon ganglion cyst. No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Small insufficiency fracture of the medial tibial plateau, with associated marrow edema.
2.	Medial meniscus tear of the body, posterior horn and posterior root attachment, with a dominant posterior horn and radial component.
3.	Moderate tricompartmental osteoarthritis with intra-articular bodies posteriorly.

COMPARISON:None.

CLINICAL HISTORY:Recent fall, suspected meniscal tear.

PROCEDURE:Multisequence, multiplanar unenhanced MRI of the left knee according to routine protocol.

IMAGING FINDINGS:

Nondiagnostic scout localizing images reviewed.

Complete radial tear posterior root medial meniscus with maceration of the posterior horn consistent with additional complex tearing, as well as peripheral extrusion of the medial meniscal body. The anterior horn is intact.

Nondisplaced inferiorly surfacing oblique tear posterior horn of the lateral meniscus. The posterior root, body, and anterior horn of the lateral meniscus are intact. No lateral meniscal extrusion.

Intact anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament.

The medial collateral ligament, posterior oblique ligament, fibular collateral ligament, popliteus and biceps femoris tendon attachments, as well as iliotibial band are intact.

The patellar retinacula are intact. No femoral trochlear dysplasia. The TT-TG distance measures 12 mm, within normal limits.

Mild quadriceps insertional tendinosis without tear. Patellar tendon is intact. Mild prepatellar/pedicle superficial soft tissue edema.

Full-thickness cartilage denuding patellar apex and extending along the medial patellar facet. Small focus of full-thickness cartilage denuding at the periphery of the lateral patellar facet. There is thinning of articular cartilage throughout the remainder of the patellar articular surface. There is fissuring of the lateral femorotibial articular cartilage. There is thinning and fissuring of medial femorotibial articular cartilage.

Small knee joint effusion. Regional musculature is within normal limits. Trace fluid in the semimembranosus tendon sheath. No suspicious focal marrow signal alteration.

IMPRESSION:
1. Complete radial tear posterior root of the medial meniscus with extensive complex tearing of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus, with medial meniscal extrusion.
2. Nondisplaced inferiorly surfacing oblique tear posterior horn of the lateral meniscus without lateral meniscal extrusion.
3. Mild quadriceps insertional tendinosis without tear.
4. Moderate tricompartment chondrosis as detailed above, consistent with mild to moderate tricompartment osteoarthritis of the left knee, most pronounced involving the patellofemoral compartment.

МР находка: Няма МР данни за ставен излив. МР данни за едемни промени на лигамента на пателата. Същият е с дифузно повишен сигнален интензитет в PDW SPAIR секвенцията на протежение от около 15 мм. Няма МР данни за скъсване на пателарния лигамент. Нормално изобразяване на сухожилието на m. quadriceps femoris. Костите, формиращи дясната колянна става са с нормална форма и сигнална характеристика. Артикулиращият хрущял на бедрената кост и тибията е със запазена цялост. Патела, хрущял на пателата – б.о. Нормално изобразяване на латералния менискус. Визуализира се лезия в задния рог на медиалния менискус. Лезията е с хоризонтален ход, като достига на единичен срез до тибиалната ставна повърност. Нормално изобразяване на предния рог на медиалния менискус. Предната и задната кръстна връзка са интактни. Колатерални лигаменти, ретинакулуми – нормално изобразяване. Не се изобразяват патологични изменения в скенираните мускулни групи. Поплитеална ямка – наличие на фабела и малка Бекерова киста. Заключение: МР данни за възпаление на лигамента на пателата /Jumper’s knee/. Парциална увреда на задния рог на медиален менискус – grade 2b. Малка Бекерова киста.

SAĞ DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Lateral menisküs normaldir.  Medial menisküs posterior horn ve gövde kesimde grade II dejenerasyon izlendi.Arka çapraz bağ, lateral kollateral ligaman normaldir.Anterior çapraz bağda miksoid dejenerasyona sekonder sinyal değişikliği izlendi.Medial kollateral ligamande periligamantöz ödem izlenmektedir.Patella medial fasette subkondral 7x4 mm boyutlu fokal osteokondral defekt izlenmektedir.Prepatellar cilt altı yağ dokuda ödem izlendi.Tibia medial platoda subartiküler fraktür ve komşu kemik iliğinde ödem ile uyumlu sinyal değişikliği izlendi.Femur medial kondilde tibiofemoral eklem komşuluğunda subkondral alanda 10x5 mm boyutlu osteokondral defekt ve komşu kemik iliğinde ödem izlendi.Femur interkondiler alan anteriorunda da subkondral alanda 9x5 mm boyutlu osteokondral defekt izlenmektedir.Diz anteroinferior kesiminde cilt altı yağ dokuda ödeme sekonder retiküler tarzda sıvı artışı izlendi.SONUÇ: Tibia medial platoda subartiküler mikrofraktür ve komşu kemik iliği ödemi. Femur medial kondilde interkondiler düzeyde ve patella medial fasette osteokondral defektler. Medial menisküste grade II meniskopati. Anterior çapraz bağda miksoid dejenerasyon. Medial kollateral ligamande grade I sprain. Prepateller cilt altı yağ dokuda ödem.

There is a complex degenerative tear through the posterior horn and root of the medial meniscus, with a predominantly radial component, with consequent significant medial extrusion at the level of the body.
There are no accompanying displaced meniscal fragment.

A small subarticular, horizontally oriented fracture line is noted at the medial tibial plateau, with accompanying surrounding marrow oedema like signal change but with no associated articular surface collapse being demonstrated. 
Diffuse grade 2/3 medial weightbearing articular cartilage damage, there is furthermore a moderate suprapatellar effusion that is communicating with a leaking, 5 cm maximal diameter Baker's cyst.

Grossly intact lateral meniscus, cruciate and lateral collateral ligaments, a grade 1 superficial MCL sprain is present.
Normal popliteus musculotendinous unit, extensor tendons and the distal iliotibial band.

No other skeletal abnormality of note, minor, focal medial retropatellar articular cartilage damage.
Well-maintained remaining patellofemoral and lateral weightbearing articular cartilage surfaces.

Grossly unremarkable remaining imaged extra-articular soft tissues.

Impression:
Unstable complex medial meniscal tear as detailed above, along with insufficiency type bony injury at the medial tibial plateau.
Temporary nonweightbearing advisable in the first instance, together with screening for possible underlying risk factors.

There is a minor knee effusion. Normal medial and lateral menisci. No evidence of tears.  Normal ACL, PCL, MCL and LCL. Normal extensor mechanism.  The tibiofemoral and patellofemoral articular cartilage is unremarkable. Normal visualized bones and surrounding soft tissues.  Conclusion: No significant abnormality identified.

Findings:  Small suprapatellar knee joint effusion. No sinister bone marrow changes. Small 10 mm x 3 mm intra-articular retropatellar soft tissue focus.  Intact cruciate and collateral ligaments.  Intact medial meniscus. Horizontal tear of the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus which breaches the inferior meniscal surface. Radial fraying of the inner free edge of the anterior horn and body of the lateral meniscus.  Normal appearance of the pes anserine tendons, popliteus tendon, distal biceps femoris tendon and distal iliotibial band.  Intact extensor mechanism. No evidence of fat pad impingement.  Minor fibrillation of the hyaline articular cartilage in the lateral tibiofemoral compartment. Otherwise well maintained tricompartmental hyaline articular cartilage.  
Conclusion:  Horizontal tear of the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus which breaches the inferior meniscal surface. Radial fraying of the inner free edge of the anterior horn and body of the lateral meniscus. Small 10 mm x 3 mm intra-articular retropatellar soft tissue focus. Possibly represents a small focus of PVNS - patient will be recalled for dedicated sequences.
